verses.original: δὲ Ὀψὲ σαββάτων τῇ ἐπιφωσκούσῃ εἰς μίαν σαββάτων Μαριὰμ ἡ Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ ἡ ἄλλη Μαρία ἦλθεν θεωρῆσαι τὸν τάφον
verses.transliteration: de Opse sabbatōn tē epiphōskousē eis mian sabbatōn Mariam hē Magdalēnē kai hē allē Maria ēlthen theōrēsai ton taphon
verses.literal: - After [the] Sabbath - at dawn on [the] first [day] of [the] week Mary - Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγένετο μέγας σεισμὸς γὰρ ἄγγελος Κυρίου καταβὰς ἐξ οὐρανοῦ καὶ προσελθὼν ἀπεκύλισεν τὸν λίθον καὶ ἐκάθητο ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai idou egeneto megas seismos gar angelos Kyriou katabas ex ouranou kai proselthōn apekylisen ton lithon kai ekathēto epanō autou
verses.literal: vvv Suddenly there was a great earthquake for an angel of [the] Lord descended from heaven - - rolled away the stone and sat on it

verses.original: δὲ αὐτοῦ ἡ εἰδέα ἦν ὡς ἀστραπὴ καὶ αὐτοῦ τὸ ἔνδυμα λευκὸν ὡς χιών
verses.transliteration: de autou hē eidea ēn hōs astrapē kai autou to endyma leukon hōs chiōn
verses.literal: - His - appearance was like lightning and his - clothes [were] white as snow

verses.original: δὲ οἱ τηροῦντες ἐσείσθησαν ἀπὸ τοῦ φόβου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐγενήθησαν ὡς νεκροί
verses.transliteration: de hoi tērountes eseisthēsan apo tou phobou autou kai egenēthēsan hōs nekroi
verses.literal: - The guards trembled in - fear of him and became like dead [men]

verses.original: δὲ ὁ ἄγγελος Ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν ταῖς γυναιξίν Μὴ φοβεῖσθε γὰρ οἶδα ὅτι ὑμεῖς ζητεῖτε Ἰησοῦν τὸν ἐσταυρωμένον
verses.transliteration: de ho angelos Apokritheis eipen tais gynaixin Mē phobeisthe gar oida hoti hymeis zēteite Iēsoun ton estaurōmenon
verses.literal: But the angel vvv said to the women {Do} not be afraid for I know that you are looking for Jesus who was crucified

verses.original: ἔστιν οὐκ ὧδε γὰρ ἠγέρθη καθὼς εἶπεν δεῦτε ἴδετε τὸν τόπον ὅπου ἔκειτο
verses.transliteration: estin ouk hōde gar ēgerthē kathōs eipen deute idete ton topon hopou ekeito
verses.literal: He is not here - He has risen just as He said Come see the place where He lay

verses.original: καὶ πορευθεῖσαι ταχὺ εἴπατε αὐτοῦ τοῖς μαθηταῖς ὅτι Ἠγέρθη ἀπὸ τῶν νεκρῶν καὶ ἰδοὺ προάγει ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν ἐκεῖ ὄψεσθε αὐτὸν ἰδοὺ εἶπον ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: kai poreutheisai tachy eipate autou tois mathētais hoti Ēgerthē apo tōn nekrōn kai idou proagei hymas eis tēn Galilaian ekei opsesthe auton idou eipon hymin
verses.literal: Then go quickly [and] tell His - disciples - He has risen from the dead and - is going ahead of you into - Galilee There you will see Him See I have told you

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπελθοῦσαι ταχὺ ἀπὸ τοῦ μνημείου μετὰ φόβου καὶ μεγάλης χαρᾶς ἔδραμον ἀπαγγεῖλαι αὐτοῦ τοῖς μαθηταῖς
verses.transliteration: Kai apelthousai tachy apo tou mnēmeiou meta phobou kai megalēs charas edramon apangeilai autou tois mathētais
verses.literal: So they hurried away . . . from the tomb in fear and great joy [and] ran to tell His - disciples

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ Ἰησοῦς ὑπήντησεν αὐταῖς λέγων Χαίρετε δὲ αἱ προσελθοῦσαι ἐκράτησαν αὐτοῦ τοὺς πόδας καὶ προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai idou Iēsous hypēntēsen autais legōn Chairete de hai proselthousai ekratēsan autou tous podas kai prosekynēsan autō
verses.literal: Suddenly . . . Jesus met them [and] said Greetings - - They came to [Him] grasped His - feet and worshiped Him

verses.original: Μὴ φοβεῖσθε τότε λέγει ὁ Ἰησοῦς αὐταῖς ὑπάγετε ἀπαγγείλατε μου τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς ἵνα ἀπέλθωσιν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν κἀκεῖ ὄψονται με
verses.transliteration: Mē phobeisthe tote legei ho Iēsous autais hypagete apangeilate mou tois adelphois hina apelthōsin eis tēn Galilaian kakei opsontai me
verses.literal: {Do} not be afraid - said - Jesus - Go [and] tell My - brothers to go to - Galilee There they will see Me

verses.original: δὲ αὐτῶν Πορευομένων ἰδού τινες τῆς κουστωδίας ἐλθόντες εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἀπήγγειλαν τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν ἅπαντα τὰ γενόμενα
verses.transliteration: de autōn Poreuomenōn idou tines tēs koustōdias elthontes eis tēn polin apēngeilan tois archiereusin hapanta ta genomena
verses.literal: While [the women] were on their way - some of the guards went into the city [and] reported to the chief priests all that had happened

verses.original: καὶ συναχθέντες μετὰ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων τε λαβόντες συμβούλιόν ἔδωκαν τοῖς στρατιώταις ἱκανὰ ἀργύρια
verses.transliteration: kai synachthentes meta tōn presbyterōn te labontes symboulion edōkan tois stratiōtais hikana argyria
verses.literal: And after [the chief priests] had met with the elders and formed a plan . . . they gave the soldiers a large sum of money

verses.original: λέγοντες Εἴπατε ὅτι αὐτοῦ Οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐλθόντες νυκτὸς ἔκλεψαν αὐτὸν ἡμῶν κοιμωμένων
verses.transliteration: legontes Eipate hoti autou Hoi mathētai elthontes nyktos eklepsan auton hēmōn koimōmenōn
verses.literal: [and] instructed them You are to say - His - disciples came by night [and] stole Him {away} {while} we were asleep

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν τοῦτο ἀκουσθῇ ἐπὶ τοῦ ἡγεμόνος ἡμεῖς πείσομεν αὐτὸν καὶ ποιήσομεν ὑμᾶς ἀμερίμνους
verses.transliteration: kai ean touto akousthē epi tou hēgemonos hēmeis peisomen auton kai poiēsomen hymas amerimnous
verses.literal: - If this [report] reaches . . . the governor we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ λαβόντες τὰ ἀργύρια ἐποίησαν ὡς ἐδιδάχθησαν Καὶ οὗτος ὁ λόγος διεφημίσθη παρὰ Ἰουδαίοις μέχρι τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας
verses.transliteration: de Hoi labontes ta argyria epoiēsan hōs edidachthēsan Kai houtos ho logos diephēmisthē para Ioudaiois mechri tēs sēmeron hēmeras
verses.literal: So the [guards] took the money [and] did as they were instructed And this - account has been circulated among [the] Jews to this very day

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ ἕνδεκα μαθηταὶ ἐπορεύθησαν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν εἰς τὸ ὄρος οὗ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐτάξατο αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: de Hoi hendeka mathētai eporeuthēsan eis tēn Galilaian eis to oros hou ho Iēsous etaxato autois
verses.literal: Meanwhile the eleven disciples went to - Galilee to the mountain . . . - Jesus had designated . . .

verses.original: καὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν προσεκύνησαν δὲ οἱ ἐδίστασαν
verses.transliteration: kai idontes auton prosekynēsan de hoi edistasan
verses.literal: When they saw Him they worshiped Him but some doubted

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς προσελθὼν αὐτοῖς ἐλάλησεν λέγων πᾶσα ἐξουσία ἐν οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς Ἐδόθη μοι
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous proselthōn autois elalēsen legōn pasa exousia en ouranō kai epi tēs gēs Edothē moi
verses.literal: Then - Jesus came to them [and] said . . . All authority in heaven and on - earth has been given to Me

verses.original: οὖν πορευθέντες μαθητεύσατε πάντα τὰ ἔθνη βαπτίζοντες αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ τοῦ Υἱοῦ καὶ τοῦ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος
verses.transliteration: oun poreuthentes mathēteusate panta ta ethnē baptizontes autous eis to onoma tou Patros kai tou Huiou kai tou Hagiou Pneumatos
verses.literal: Therefore go [and] make disciples of all - nations baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit

verses.original: διδάσκοντες αὐτοὺς τηρεῖν πάντα ὅσα ἐνετειλάμην ὑμῖν καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ εἰμι μεθ’ ὑμῶν πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας ἕως τῆς συντελείας τοῦ αἰῶνος
verses.transliteration: didaskontes autous tērein panta hosa eneteilamēn hymin kai idou egō eimi meth’ hymōn pasas tas hēmeras heōs tēs synteleias tou aiōnos
verses.literal: [and] teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you And surely I am with you always . . . . . . even to the end of the age
